'''Diedrich Greyshade''' was a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Commonality]]. A cousin of [[Simon Greyshade/Legends|Simon Greyshade]], it was due to Diedrich's influence that Simon's culpability in the death of their cousin [[Jheramahd Greyshade]] was never discovered, allowing Simon to become [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the Commonality.<ref name="Viva Space Vegas">{{SW|url=news/viva-space-vegas-the-history-of-the-marvelous-wheel-part-2|series=Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> After the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] was disbanded, Simon Greyshade abandoned the Commonality to Diedrich.<ref name="Geonosis" />
